listing_info.listing_name: Lakefront Home Near Wolfeboro-5BR, Sauna & Kayaks
listing_info.description:
Escape to a spacious, private lakefront retreat on peaceful Shaw Pond, just minutes from downtown Wolfeboro. This 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath home features 3 primary suites, 2 kitchens, a sauna, multiple fireplaces and plenty of space for families and groups. Enjoy direct waterfront access, kayaks, expansive outdoor living, a putting/chipping area, grilling and a wood-burning outdoor fireplace—all in a quiet, private setting perfect for year-round getaways.

The space
The entire home is yours to enjoy. Designed with large families and groups in mind, this spacious lakefront home offers plenty of room to spread out, gather together and enjoy the property year-round.

Inside the Home:

- 5 bedrooms, including 3 primary suites
- 5.5 bathrooms
- Main kitchen connected to the family room
- Second kitchen on the walkout lower level
- 2-person sauna
- Sonos speakers upstairs and downstairs
- Multiple indoor fireplaces
- 4-car garage and plenty of parking

Outdoor Living:

The upper deck offers plenty of seating, a wood-burning outdoor fireplace and a TV—perfect for watching the game while enjoying the outdoors. The walkout lower level opens directly to another patio and the backyard.

Outside you'll also find:

- Turf area for putting, chipping and lawn games
- Pit Boss smoker
- Gas grill
- Outdoor shower
- Multiple seating and gathering areas

Private Waterfront:

Follow the private walkway down to the water, where you'll have your own beach and dock. Relax by the water, go for a swim or take the provided kayaks out on peaceful Shaw Pond. After a day on the lake, rinse off in the outdoor shower before heading back inside.

Nearby:

Enjoy a quiet, private lakefront setting while still being close to some of the Lakes Region's best destinations:

- Kingswood Golf Club — 8 minutes
- Downtown Wolfeboro — 10 minutes
- Mount Major — 20 minutes
- Gunstock Mountain Resort — 27 minutes

Whether you're planning a summer lake getaway, golf weekend, fall escape or winter ski trip, the home is set up for families and groups to enjoy New Hampshire in every season.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the entire home and property with convenient keyless entry at the main entrance.

The garage, attic, and lower-level utility/storage areas are reserved for the owners and are not accessible to guests. All other living spaces, outdoor areas, waterfront, private beach, dock, and provided amenities are available for guests to enjoy.

Other things to note
No Pets: Pets are not permitted anywhere on the property.

No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the home. Evidence of indoor smoking may result in a $200 additional cleaning charge for air purification and odor removal.

If our cleaning crew is required to pick up cigarette butts or smoking-related debris anywhere on the property, an additional $150 cleaning charge may apply. Please dispose of all cigarette butts properly in the outdoor trash receptacles.

Sauna: The sauna has a maximum capacity of 4 people. Please use it responsibly and follow all posted instructions.

Kayaks & Waterfront: Please treat the provided kayaks with care and return them upside down after each use to prevent them from collecting water. The waterfront, dock, and kayaks are used at guests' own risk. Children should always be supervised around the water.

Noise: Please remember that sound travels easily across the lake. Be respectful of our neighbors, particularly during the evening. Outdoor gatherings should remain closer to the house rather than along the beach and waterfront.

Security Cameras: Exterior security cameras are located around the property for security purposes. Additional cameras are located inside the garage, attic, and lower-level utility/storage rooms, all of which are restricted areas and not accessible to guests. There are no cameras in any guest-accessible indoor living spaces, bedrooms, bathrooms, or other private areas.

We appreciate you treating the home, property, amenities, and surrounding lake community with care and respect during your stay.

Perfect for families and friends, our spacious lakeside retreat is the ideal getaway in every season. Enjoy beach days and outdoor adventures in the summer, or explore hiking trails, skiing, and ice fishing during the winter months. Relax and unwind in comfort with our newly installed central air conditioning, and take advantage of the private beach just a 5-minute walk away.

The space
We bought this charming lake house as a perfect year around retreat to raise our extremely energetic twin boys. The spacious layout provides stunning views, plenty of room to unwind or socialize, and a private beach just a 5-minute walk away.

As passionate travelers, we know how important it is to create lasting memories with loved ones. That’s why we are excited to share our home with fellow adventurers who value the joy of spending time with family and friends.

PS. This is a new home for us, and while we’ve made a lot of improvements and are still adding the final touch-ups, we’re continuing to learn more about the house. We recently added central AC amongst other things. We’d love your feedback and suggestions as we work to make it our perfect home. We also hope you love our home as much as we do.

Guest access
Guests have access to the full house including the private beach. Per association rules, max number of guests at the beach is limited to 12 guests/house. In season the day dock is available for up to a maximum of 1 hour per day.

Other things to note
This is a new home for us, and while we’ve made a lot of improvements and are still adding the final touch-ups, we’re continuing to learn more about the house. We’d love your feedback and suggestions as we work to make it our perfect home. We also hope you love our home as much as we do.

Relax with the whole family at this private, peaceful cottage on Balch Lake with multiple decks and swimming areas. Water views from nearly every room and multiple places to gather together inside and outside. Enjoy s'mores or drinks around the firepit or take a nap in the hammock and listen to the waves lap the shore.

Charming waterfront home overlooking the Broads and Ellacoya Beach on Winnipesaukee. Main level offers incredible lake and mountain views and open entertaining space. Just across the walking-friendly street, 300' of sandy-bottom  waterfront, large dock, grassy area, fire pit & furniture. Your boat can dock during day and be moored at night.  Pics will be updated in June 2026 as we are In process of renovating kitchen and building new deck on front of house.

listing_info.listing_name: Summer on a private sanctuary of 17 acres
listing_info.description:
Summer '25 lake time is here! Relax with the whole family & friends at this private paradise. With 17 acres of fields, forest, brook, marsh, 280' of lake frontage on the exclusive class A Lake Wentworth, hot tub, kayak, canoe, ping pong, spacious western facing deck, bball, gorgeous sunsets, 4 bedrooms, screened in porch for summer dinners with gas burning stove, chef's kitchen, fire place, NEW DUCTLESS HEATING & COOLING UNITS in bedrooms, living room & kitchen, you will never want to leave.

The space
The two story house plus basement has a primary bedroom with half bath on the 2nd floor with two additional bedrooms (one room with full-size bed and views of the lake, one room with two twin size beds and a queen-size futon couch, and views toward the fields and forest), a central room with desk and lake views, and a full bath. The first story has a chef's eat in kitchen, large living room with fireplace, bedroom with queen-size bed, full bathroom, and a screened in porch with gas iron stove. A large redwood deck, accessible from sliding doors in the kitchen and living room, with teak table, Weber gas grill, and teak lounge chairs provides ample space for entertaining, relaxation, gorgeous sunsets, and even games of corn hole. The deluxe hot tub is at the southern end of the deck nestled among birch and pines trees and full privacy. The basement is for ping pong, late night poker games, and laundry.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the full house with the exception to a storage closet in the basement and one closet upstairs.

Other things to note
The house is a perfect sanctuary for writers, bird watchers (numerous birds including a peregrine falcon and bald eagles are regularly on the property), naturalists, lake and water sports enthusiasts, or really anyone just wanting full privacy, natural beauty, and peace. Although any property that has water on it requires attentive parents for small children, the property is a wonderland for children who can run free and explore. The shallow beach is also excellent for small children. For those looking for deeper water, it is best to kayak or swim out to the point. The tennis court is in disrepair and needs to be completely resurfaced but provides entertainment for those just goofing around or wishing to shoot a few hoops. In July and August, Stamp Act Island, run by the Nature Conservancy, is open to the public. It is a 5 minute power boat ride or 15 minutes kayak from our dock. It has a gorgeous beach and beautiful swimming. Bring your boat if you have one or rent one. We use our FourWinns 17.5' boat on a daily basis when we are at the property. On the far side of Stamp Act is the "sandbar" where both kids and adults love to go to play in the water. Wentworth Lake is excellent for both waterskiing and sailing as well as swimming and other water sports. If you like fishing, Lake Wentworth is one of the best lakes in NH and a regular stop on the pro-bass tour. Its rocky bottom and various rock ledges provide excellent homes for small and large mouth bass. Finally, Lake Wentworth is a quiet lake. Public boat access is only made through the adjacent Crescent Lake, which means the vast majority of boats on the lake belong to those who reside on the lake . You are often the only boat on the lake and the Wentworth community is kind and respectful. The Wentworth Association takes upmost care to make sure that lake remains pristine.

Beautiful lakefront property with great views, 150' frontage and a large flat lawn in quiet Edmund's Cove with direct access to the water. This much-loved property has had summer renters returning year after year; one family for 15 years in a row!

The space
The cove faces south, protected from wind on most days making for ideal swimming and sunning. The expansive and level lawn leads to a beach, a stairway to deeper water, and a boathouse. The boathouse contains two canoes, beach chairs, and even a boat slip for up to 23' boat. A sandy swim area with gradual entrance to the lake is perfect for small children.
The property contains two houses joined by a very large cathedral screened porch. The separate living spaces offer a unique combination of privacy and togetherness, spread across a generous layout. Each house has its own kitchen, dining area, bedrooms, bathrooms, and washers/dryers. The main house also has a large deck, ping pong/pool room, and two car garage. This property has everything a family could ask for in a stunning, private setting.

Note : During the last two weeks of June through the end of August rentals are for a minimum of 7 nights beginning and ending on Saturdays. To see available weeks during that timeframe, click on the available Saturdays on the calendar.

Guest access
The entire property is accessible for use.

listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful Historic Home one block to Village
listing_info.description:
Stay at an historic village home on Wolfeboro’s most beloved street. This 4-br, 1.5-bath Colonial home’s large private backyard, idyllic screened porch and historic charm form the perfect place to relax. You’ll be steps to the Wolfeboro Inn, a very short walk to town docks, restaurants, ice cream shops, and all the amenities of “America’s Oldest Summer Resort”. No need to get back in your car but if you want to explore further there are numerous parks, ski resorts, museums, etc.

The space
4 BR, 1.5 BA Just steps from Wolfeboro Village
this 4-br, 1.5-bath colonial home offers a rare opportunity to experience the charm of a New England historic home. Located on a quiet tree lined New Hampshire Street, it’s peaceful flowing outdoor space allows families to enjoy an afternoon wiffle ball game, a family cookout, or quiet retreat with a good book. The location, just steps from the Wolfeboro Inn, town docks and the Abenaki Trails adds to its unique year round vacation features.

The spacious indoor living area includes 4 bedrooms 1.5 baths, a large family dining area just off the easy to navigate kitchen. The comfortable living room has a large screen smart tv, with Wi-Fi speeds for your streaming pleasures. There is a screened in porch, with inviting cozy furnishings, that creates the backdrop of family memories.

I try to leave the home the same way I do for visiting family, all cotton mostly organic bedding, fully stocked kitchen, lots of towels for indoor and out, games, books, guides, throw pillows and blankets. I really want our guests to enjoy their stay and have all the comforts they need.

Wolfeboro Bay, lays comfortably on the shores of New Hampshire’s largest lake, Lake Winnipesaukee. Wolfeboro can honorably boast “America’s Oldest Summer Resort”. The preservation of the small-town charm, allows you to relive your own childhood memories, or create new ones. The season extends well beyond traditional summer vacations. With breathtaking Autumn foliage to enjoy, to cross country ski trails right outside your door. Gunstock Ski area is a brief 20-minute drive away, or the Abenaki ski trails minutes away. and of course, the famous lake ice fishing. Spring bursts into bloom, a wonderful kickstart to the warm summer season.

The house is conveniently located, just a quick walk into the charming village of Wolfeboro, for a wide selection of restaurants, ice cream, sandwich and coffee shops. There is a wonderful variety of stores, along the well-maintained sidewalks, many featuring local artists works. Its convenience enjoyed by guests of the Wolfeboro Inns many events.

The picturesque docks are a few minute walk away where you can board the famed Mt. Washington ship. During the warmer season’s book a sunset dinner, or catch a ride on the mailboat, as it delivers mail to the hundreds of islands that rest lazily on the lake. You can choose to rent a boat (or bring your own) and explore the scenic mountain lined Winnie on your own. This amazing crystal-clear spring fed lake offers swimming, fishing, kayaking, with all levels of experience.

In the basement you will find two bikes, an inflatable paddle board, two kayaks, a lawn bocce set, wiffle ball set and various beach supplies. Please no children in the basement without adult supervision as there are tools and other various dangers.

We love being able to share the area we enjoyed as children. Send me an inquiry if you have any questions about the house and/or area.
We look forward to helping you enjoy this beautiful home and area.

Other things to note
we have a Ring security camera on the front door looking out. No other cameras are at this property.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- This multi-level home requires stairs for entry; the main level features 1 bedroom and 1 full bathroom

This property features 5 exterior security cameras: camera 1 is on the front door facing the entry, cameras 2 and 3 are floodlight cameras facing the front, and cameras 4 and 5 are floodlight cameras facing the back. The cameras do not look into any interior spaces. The cameras record video and audio when activated by motion

Your private 🌲 waterfront escape in New Hampshire’s Lakes Region

Leave the crowds behind and step into lake life done right.

With 102 feet of private shoreline, Sunset Cove is all about easy, carefree days on the water — the kind where you lose track of time and don’t want to leave.

💦 Crystal-clear water
🏖 Sandy bottom + gradual walk-in (NO muck!)
⭐️Perfect for kids, floating, and all-day swimming

No weeds. No squishy lake bottom. Just clean, refreshing water you can walk right into.

🌿 Calm mornings, glassy water, peaceful surroundings

Perfect setup for families or small groups traveling together:

• Bedroom 1 – King bed + ensuite bath
• Bedroom 2 – King bed

⸻

✨ Amenities That Make It Easy

• Central A/C for hot summer days
• High-speed Wi-Fi (if you need it 😉)
• Smart TVs + board games
• Fully stocked kitchen (Keurig, dishwasher & cookware)
• Washer & dryer
• Whole-house generator
• Cozy gas stove for cooler nights 🔥

⸻

🌊 Your Private Lakefront Playground

This is what makes Sunset Cove special:

• 102 ft of private shoreline
• 💦 Clear water + sandy bottom — no muck, no weeds
• 🏖 Gradual walk-in entry (perfect for kids & easy swimming)
• Private dock with ladder + boat tie-up
• 3 kayaks, 2 paddleboards & pedal boat (great for kids!)

• Private hot tub area under the stars 🌌

You’ll spend most of your time outside — and you’ll want to!

☀️ Spring & Summer Highlights

This is lake season at its best:

🌅 Morning coffee on the deck with loon calls
🛶 Early paddles on calm, glassy water
🏖 Easy, all-day swimming right from your shoreline
🍔 Grilling + lakeside dinners

🐾 Dog Friendly

📍 Location — Wakefield, NH

Peaceful lakeside setting, but close to all the good stuff:

Local favorites (super close):

🛶 Or just stay close and explore right from your dock

Easy day trips:

🚠 Cranmore Mountain Resort – summer activities + scenic views

🏡 Peaceful Lakeside Community

Perfect for guests looking to relax and enjoy the lake:

• Primary guest must be 25+
• Maximum occupancy: 8
• All guests must be listed
• ID may be required
•Rental Agreement required after booking. No 3rd party bookings.

🔇 Quiet hours: 10 PM – 8 AM. Absolutely no parties. This is a residential area of lake where people live year round.

Exterior Ring cameras + noise monitoring in place.

🔐 Guest Access

You’ll have private access to:

• Entire home
• Dock & yard
• Kayaks, paddleboards, pedal boat & life vests
• Fire pit (weather permitting)
• Gas grill
• Hot tub

🚫 Not accessible: garage, locked storage areas, hill behind home, 3rd floor of house is the locked attic.

✔ Smart lock self check-in
🕒 Check-in: 3 PM | Check-out: 10 AM

🌅 The Sunset Cove Experience

☕ Coffee on the deck while the lake is still
🛶 Quiet paddles across crystal-clear water
🏖 Easy swimming with a sandy, no-muck shoreline
🔥 Evenings by the fire
♨️ Hot tub nights under the stars

✨ Simple, fun, and exactly what a lake vacation should feel like

Guest access
Guests have access to the lower level and main level on second floor.

The third floor is currently unfinished, used as storage and off limits.

The garage and property behind up on the hill are also off limits.

Enough parking for 4 cars at the house.

Extra parking is available upon request, including parking for a boat trailer if needed.

Private access to 102' of clear, sandy water frontage with gradual entry.

Other things to note
There is a quiet, private dirt road between the house and the water frontage. 102' Ft of water frontage belong to the property and is available for guests. Pine River Pond is almost 600 acres and isn't open to the public.

Exterior camera on property facing entrance for insurance purposes. They are not monitored and there for everyone's safety.

Feel free to bring boat or jetski- the dock has two sides available for use. Jet skis have to be 3 seaters per lake regulations. Message for more info on this.

🦌 A Note About Nature 🐞
We’re tucked away in beautiful New Hampshire, which means you may see (or hear!) some of the local wildlife. From fireflies and the occasional mosquito to deer, loons, and even the rare black bear sighting, nature is part of the charm here. While we do our best to keep the house comfortable and pest-free, you may still come across bugs or critters outdoors. It’s all part of the NH lake & woods experience — think of it as sharing your getaway with the locals. 🌲✨

listing_info.listing_name: Lake Winniepesaukee, boat slip, dogs welcome!
listing_info.description:
Spring Harbor Lodge is a beautifully restored 1930 lakeside home on Lake Winnipesaukee, set along a peaceful channel leading to Smith Cove. One of two homes on this scenic property, it offers water views, a private boat slip (up to 25 ft., summer), and timeless charm with thoughtful modern updates. Just minutes from Gunstock Ski Area, BankNH Pavilion, and local attractions, it's the perfect place to relax and enjoy lakeside living.

The space
Step back in time while enjoying all the modern comforts at Spring Harbor Lodge, a beautifully restored 1930s home on Lake Winnipesaukee. Nestled along the peaceful channel leading to Smith Cove, this inviting lakeside retreat offers vintage character, cozy gathering spaces, and stunning sunset views over the water.

Thoughtfully updated to meet every guest’s needs, the Lodge comfortably hosts up to 10 guests while preserving its original charm.

Main Floor:
The first floor features a queen bedroom, a ¾ bath, an updated kitchen with direct access to the sunroom, a classic dining room, a deck with seating, and a comfortable living room perfect for relaxing after a day on the water.

Upstairs:
The second floor includes a newly remodeled full bathroom with double sinks and a shower, plus three welcoming bedrooms:
Primary: King-size bed
Second: Queen-size bed
Third: Queen-size + full-size bed

Lower Level:
Head downstairs to the game room for a friendly match of pool, ping pong, or darts—a fun spot for guests of all ages.

Outdoor Enjoyment:
Sip your morning coffee or evening wine on the deck overlooking the channel, or relax in the front sunroom. Gather around the gas fire pit for cozy evenings. Guests have access to a shared dock with a designated boat slip for boats up to 25 feet. Four kayaks and four bicycles are available to share between the two homes for exploring the lake and local area.

The Glendale Town Docks are just 2 minutes away, offering two public launch ramps, and a boat launch pass is available upon request.

Pet Policy:
We welcome one small dog (under 50 lbs) per reservation. Please provide the breed and weight when booking. A pet fee doe apply. Cats and other animals are not permitted.

Nearby Attractions:
1 min – Glendale Yacht Club
2 mins – Gilford Beach
5 mins – Bank of NH Pavilion
7 mins – Ellacoya State Park Beach
10 mins – Gunstock Mountain Resort
15 mins – Weirs Beach
20 mins – Downtown Meredith
25 mins – Tanger Outlets

Whether you’re watching the sunset from the deck, playing a game downstairs, or heading out for a day on the lake, Spring Harbor Lodge offers the perfect blend of vintage lakeside charm and modern comfort for an unforgettable stay on Lake Winnipesaukee.

Guest access
Spring Harbor is a beautiful 2-acre waterfront property featuring two rental homes — Spring Harbor Lodge and The Cottage at Spring Harbor — each offering a peaceful lakeside experience. Guests staying at the Lodge have full access to their private rental home, designated parking spaces, and one boat slip on the shared dock. To make the most of your stay, enjoy use of four kayaks and four bicycles, which are shared between both homes for exploring the lake and surrounding area.

Other things to note
Spring Harbor is a shared property with two rental homes located on the 2 acres. We ask that you please be respectful of the other renters during your stay.
